row.evidence: BMC Helix documents user import only through Helix Single Sign-On logon-time import from a SAML IdP, an LDAP sync agent, or sync from BMC Helix ITSM; its documentation has no SCIM endpoint, and pricing is by request ('discuss pricing options based on your requirements').
row.notes: New row. BMC Helix (ITSM, ITOM/AIOps, Digital Workplace) now runs as BMC Helix, Inc. at helixops.ai (bmc.com/it-solutions/bmc-helix redirects there); researched the shared admin layer, BMC Helix Portal with Helix Single Sign-On, which fronts the other Helix products. No public pricing (Request Pricing form). Identity sources: SAML/OIDC through Helix SSO with users and groups imported at logon (JIT), an on-prem LDAP sync agent (recommended for large volumes), and sync of licensed users from BMC Helix ITSM. A solr search of docs.helixops.ai for 'scim', 'SCIM 2.0', '/scim/v2' and 'System for Cross-domain Identity Management' found no SCIM docs. Okta's catalogue has no Helix app; 'BMC Remedyforce' (a separate Salesforce-based product) is an OIN SAML/SCIM app and is not this row. Helix Portal has a REST user/group API (JWT from access keys) with create, update, activate/deactivate and delete.

endpoints.purpose: Get all users under a tenant
Update general details of a user
Update the status of a user (activate or deactivate a user)
Get all user groups under a tenant
Get details of a specific user group
Update general details of a user group
Update users associated with a user group
Replace users associated with a user group

limitations.text: JWT expires after 15 minutes and the refresh token after 24 hours.
Users synced from BMC Helix ITSM cannot be created or updated from the Helix Portal console; their lifecycle follows ITSM.

okta.notes: OIN search for 'Helix' returns no results; 'BMC' returns BMC Remedyforce (SAML, SCIM), BMC AppZone and BMC Atrium Single Sign-On, none of which is BMC Helix. Helix SSO docs say Okta works as a SAML IdP.

entra.notes: No BMC Helix entry in the Microsoft Learn Entra SaaS tutorial index.

fallbacks.other_sync: Helix Portal LDAP sync agent (users, groups, mappings); sync of licensed users and groups from BMC Helix ITSM; BMC Helix ITSM Data Management LDAP/LDAPS import.
